title: Generate an Angular MFE Widget container
description: Scaffolds a zoneless Angular 19 Widget container: a non-routable, self-mounting definition made with @company/mfe-angular's createWidget and PrimeNG, built by @nx/angular:webpack-browser with @company/mfe-nx/webpack's withMfe() into a Module Federation remote.

name.x-prompt: What name should this Widget project have?

id.description: The MFE definition id. Lower-case letters, digits and single hyphens (e.g. "alert-panel"); it becomes the federation container name, the storage prefix and the CSS scope value. Defaults to the kebab-cased project name.

directory.description: The project root, relative to the workspace root. Defaults to apps/<name>.

port.description: The dev server port this container's manifest is served from.

packageName.description: The generated project's own package.json name. Defaults to @example/<id>.

skipPackageJson.description: Do not add the container's dependencies to the workspace package.json.
